notes_for_editor: Only the FFLA listing (standing, Buchanan County) and RoadOnMap (a place-name site naming Keen Mountain Fire Tower, 2,710 ft) name the tower. Two other map sites (anyplaceamerica, getamap) returned HTTP 403 and were not used. The Wikipedia page is about the community, not the tower. The story no longer says the page omits a tower, since that negative cannot be quoted. An article on the Keen Mountain coal camp was read and does not mention a tower. Two web searches found no build date, builder, design, staffing, ownership or access record. Confidence low.
